div.div: Every metric has a source it is read from and a pitfall that misreads it - four groups, read all four or the result lies
CPU (B0)

CPU usage in CORES
source: cgroup cpu.stat (time / window)
pitfall: convert to cores, not %, to compare across machines

quota throttling
source: cgroup cpu.max, cpu.stat (nr_throttled, throttled_usec)
pitfall: throttled_usec is SUMMED over run-queues, NOT unmet demand - report fraction of throttled periods

per-core busy
source: /proc/stat
pitfall: pool near 100% busy = CPU is the limit

run-queue wait
source: /proc/schedstat
pitfall: rising wait (not GPU-busy) is the CPU-bound signature

load average
source: kernel loadavg
pitfall: counts runnable+waiting incl. spikes; pair with per-core busy

foreign-CPU census
source: per-window process list
pitfall: > ~0.3 cores foreign => window suspect [foreign_cpu_gate_illustrative]
GPU + MEMORY (B1)

GPU-busy (GR3D %)
source: tegrastats GR3D
pitfall: TIME a kernel ran, NOT occupancy; calibrate vs kernel-time trace

utilization.gpu
source: nvidia-smi
pitfall: also a time fraction; can read below true busy - calibrate

memory-controller index (EMC %)
source: tegrastats EMC
pitfall: integer RELATIVE to current mem clock, not GB/s; lock the clock

power rails
source: tegrastats rails
pitfall: coarse steps; GPU+SoC may share a rail - no sub-step claims

memory: MemAvailable / cgroup / nvmap
source: /proc/meminfo, memory.current, nvmap
pitfall: do NOT sum cgroup + GPU mem (overlap/uncharged); use MemAvailable as the honest total

clock lock
source: GPU + mem clock regime
pitfall: verify lock at BOTH window ends or the counters are incomparable
RATES + LATENCY + STATS (B2, B3)

topic rate + period p50/p95/p99
source: topic probes (msg timestamps)
pitfall: a SOFTWARE-capped rate is a ceiling, not a compute limit

receive-time vs header-stamp latency
source: subscriber clock vs sender stamp
pitfall: mixing bases silently adds the clock offset to every number

cross-machine clock offset
source: SNTP probe (several/sec)
pitfall: bound must be < smallest latency measured [clock_offset_target_illustrative]

clock-free latency
source: two arrivals on the SAME machine
pitfall: the primary latency when the offset bound is too large

deadline misses/min + p99 tail
source: per-cycle times (control loop)
pitfall: Garwood Poisson interval; tails not means; block bootstrap for autocorrelation

sample-count rule
source: window length from B3
pitfall: too few samples => p99 noisy => flag the window, do not trust
PROFILERS (B4)

tegrastats
source: periodic one-line summary
pitfall: cheap/coarse; duty + power only

Nsight Systems (timeline)
source: kernel + API timeline
pitfall: MED intrusion: adds ~ms latency [nsys_perturbation_illustrative]; KPIs from UNTRACED windows only

Nsight Compute (counters)
source: per-kernel hardware counters
pitfall: HIGH intrusion: serialises + replays kernels; take STRUCTURE not wall-times; never beside control loop

union of kernel intervals
source: nsys timeline
pitfall: the true GPU-busy to CALIBRATE the coarse GR3D counter

profiler safety
source: privileged container
pitfall: min privilege, logged, time-bounded; NEVER next to the control loop

Legend
Four colour groups = four metric families: blue CPU, green GPU+memory, amber rates+latency+stats, purple profilers.
Every card carries: the metric name, the SOURCE it is read from, and the PITFALL that misreads it.
Rule: the headline KPIs (rates, latencies, misses) come from UNTRACED windows; profilers run in separate,
labelled trace-only windows for MECHANISM, never for a KPI (B4).

Source: B0 (cgroup cpu.stat/cpu.max, /proc/stat, /proc/schedstat, loadavg, foreign-CPU census); B1 (tegrastats GR3D/EMC/rails, nvidia-smi, MemAvailable /proc/meminfo, cgroup memory.current, nvmap, clock lock); B2 (topic rate + period percentiles, receive vs header stamp, SNTP offset RFC 4330, clock-free latency); B3 (misses/min Garwood Poisson interval, p99 tails, sample-count rule, moving-block bootstrap); B4 (tegrastats / Nsight Systems / Nsight Compute, union of kernel intervals, profiler safety). Illustrative thresholds from constants.json as tagged. No measured robot numbers.
